forwardView: 18 months out: Fed hiking toward 4.25-4.50% (BofA: Dec '26 + Mar '27) into already-restrictive real rates with M2 surging 10-12%. This is a policy error risk — hiking to 4.5% without breaking something is historically unprecedented. Two scenarios: (a) inflation stays sticky, Fed keeps hiking → dollar stronger near-term, risk assets pressured, gold eventually wins on inflation debasement; (b) economy cracks, Fed forced to pivot → dollar weakens, risk assets rally, gold also wins. Either way, gold wins 18 months out but TIMING is premature (broke $3,950 support, at $3,876 now, needs $3,800 washout or $4,000 reclaim). NEAR TERM (3-6 months): dollar strength dominates. EUR short is the cleanest expression. December hike is now consensus (100% of economists) — the question is whether they go 50bps. Patience on longs — wait for the crack or the washout. Cash is a position.
